actions.action: Classify scene reachability with inspectable evidence
actions.mechanism: Analyze scene-and-state pairs; distinguish reachable, proven unreachable, and unexplored within declared limits.
actions.implementation: Declare initial states and analysis limits. Attach witness paths to reachable scenes and inspectable blocking-condition proofs to unreachable scenes.
actions.check: Replay each witness. Verify a contradictory gate is proven unreachable while a reachable scene beyond the budget remains unexplored.
actions.risk: Unsupported embedded code must produce uncertainty, not an unreachability proof.

actions.action: Distinguish temporary loops from proven traps
actions.mechanism: Track state changes across repeated scenes; prove traps only when reachable state sets have no possible escape.
actions.implementation: Analyze cyclic regions with state-aware exit conditions. Display an entry trace, recurring states, and evidence blocking every exit.
actions.check: Test a counter initialized to zero: increment each visit; exit at three. Then cap it at two and verify a trap proof.
actions.risk: A repeated scene alone does not prove a trap.

actions.mechanism: Intent annotations acknowledge specific findings without excluding scenes or branches from analysis.
actions.implementation: Store finding type, affected choices, rationale, and relevant condition/update fingerprints. Invalidate acknowledgments when those dependencies change; retain underlying evidence.
actions.check: Acknowledge a deliberate loop and hidden scene. Confirm a separate impossible exit still warns and changed gates reopen affected findings.
actions.risk: Scene-wide suppression would conceal unrelated defects; disallow it.

actions.action: Replay diagnostic paths against actual story execution
actions.mechanism: Differential replay exposes disagreements between analyzed transitions and actual condition evaluation or state updates.
actions.implementation: Add a diagnostic runner logging initial state, choices, gate results, and updates. Replay warning traces and generated reachable boundary cases.
actions.check: Inject an off-by-one update mismatch; verify the runner identifies its first divergent transition and preserves the reproducible trace.
actions.risk: Successful replay validates tested executions only; it cannot establish unreachability.
